title: Resolve material assumptions
summary: Run small experiments only when their evidence can change the decision.

sections.label: Compare options proportionately
sections.text: Shortlist the existing engineer-assisted process, credible simpler automation and bounded agent options. The study need not build three prototypes.

sections.label: Candidate experiments
rows: Small isolated replay with dependencies recorded.
Reviewed cases, independent checks and intervention logs.
Configuration review or narrow connectivity demonstration.

sections.label: Experiment contract
sections.text: Name the assumption, owner, timebox, expected evidence and decision it could change. Prioritize consequential uncertainty.

sections.label: Conditional completion
sections.text: The study can finish with a named uncertainty and costed next experiment. A feasibility ticket is not a requirement to build production.

sections.label: Architecture guidance
sections.text: Anthropic recommends added complexity when it improves outcomes; its older article explicitly notes tooling changes. This guidance does not establish a winning model, agent count or engine here.

basis: Ticket-scoped recommendation; not an implemented workplace capability
confidence: Moderate for fit; workplace benefit unknown

catalog.applicability: Illustrative context. Compare its assumptions with your own work.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
